gate.label: TrueDepth accepted · combined queue archived
gate.detail: The full MySlate TrueDepth take remains accepted. The UE 5.8.1 combined face+body queue is complete: Loose sway approved, four long vertical takes archived as candidates with coverage limits, VID_1–4 retained as partial-body diagnostics, and hand-only VID_5 rejected.

proofs.label: Full repaired take
proofs.summary: The accepted full TrueDepth performance, shown as one clean Unreal render with the approved Abby presentation camera, map and lighting.
proofs.verdict: Accepted for non-destructive face/head transfer. Only the known 17–26 second over-expression interval is damped; the rest of the full v040 performance is unchanged.
proofs.depthDiagnostic: The under-120 px TrueDepth face-width warning remains in the original solve. The selected v043 family repair corrects the proven neutral-interval amplitude failure without replacing the depth solve.
lineage: selected repair proof v043 / gate v045
observations: No previous Unreal performance take and no video-only tracking were used.
The selected repair changes face-control excursion only from 17–26 seconds, with boundary ramps; head and neck timing remain at 100%.
The first full render v048 exposed startup hair deformation and was preserved as diagnostic evidence. Render v049 adds warm-up before frame zero without trimming or retiming the animation.
The site movie is H.264/avc1, 960 × 540, 30 fps, browser fast-start verified and SHA-256 matched after private Dropbox transfer.
Canonical Abby Unreal, C4D and source-capture assets remain untouched.
